scope: Randomized variants of the rotation values and actions that refused real production requests, applied to 67 accepted requests: includeReactionTime on the player's aura activity reads of 15 Mage, Druid, Shaman, Warrior, Rogue, Paladin and Warlock requests, dotBaseDuration in the dot casts of 16 Warlock, Priest, Hunter and Druid requests (one in a set bonus that adds a tick as the reset activates it), AllTargets and AllPlayers in every other dot and aura read of 13 Warlock, Priest, Hunter, Druid and Mage requests at 1 to 5 targets, a weaving and a timeline of moves in the priority list of 8 Hunter requests at 1 to 5 targets, each with a prepull run, and the 7 accepted fixtures of these gaps. 342 variants at 200 iterations, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. Each variant draws its race from the races of its class and keeps the weapons of its base.
generator: python3 tools/rotation_gaps_sweep.py --output <scratch>, which draws the variants of tools/sweep.py (seed 20261008 plus the row's position, 200 iterations, 3 to 8 variants of each) from the accepted requests with their rotation changed by one transform, restoring the base's main hand, off hand and ranged weapon in each; each variant <scratch>/NAME-sweep-NN.request.json is compared as variants/NAME-sweep-NN.request.json

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every variant matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log. 112 variants move a Hunter in the first fight: the weaving and timeline rows of 8 Hunter requests and the two Hunter fixtures with moves. The timeline row runs the Hunter into the dead zone inside 8 yards, where the bow cannot fire, and into melee range.

The variants lower talents, drop buffs, debuffs, consumables and gear other than the weapons, and change the target level, distance, reaction time and random stream mode. They keep the weapons because a Hunter without its bow has a ranged weapon of zero swing speed, whose shots Go computes as NaN.

A first draw that let the sweep drop weapons made the pinned Go engine itself fail on two variants of the weaving row at 5 targets, with a panic in the Emerald Dragon Whelp's rotation (cannot wait negative time); the drawn variants have none.
